name: models3d_segment
description: Split a model into parts. Tripo (default): semantic parts; complete hidden geometry with models3d_complete using the result. Hi3D: body parts of a character or any model by granularity; its result cannot be completed.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

splitMode.description: Hi3D only. character (default): body parts; general: any model, by `splitLevel`.

splitParts.description: Hi3D character. a 6 parts (default), b 5, c 4 without head, d 4 with head, e 3, f 2.
